annotations.title: ToolRoute: Route a task to the right tools

description:
Which of my tools does this task need? Send "set_id" (from register_tools) or "tools", plus "query" (the task). Returns a ranked shortlist (adaptive 3-12 tools, or "k"), confidence (high/medium/low/none), matched terms, token savings and the definitions ready to inject ("format": mcp, openai, anthropic, gemini or names). BM25 keyword ranking, no LLM. Free: 200 calls/day per IP, then $0.001 per call via x402 or credits.
Not for: tool sets small enough to send whole (under about 10 tools).

[ToolRoute via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as ToolRoute's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: route $0.001 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

format.description: Definition format (default mcp; names = names only)

max_k.description: Upper bound for the adaptive size (default 12)

query.description: The task or user request to route, e.g. "check if this wallet is sanctioned".

set_id.description: set_id ("ts_..." from register, or a ToolFit pin).

tier.description: Paid tier: route $0.001. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.

tools.description: Tool definitions (MCP, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Bedrock form), max 500. For route: only if you have no set_id (the set is registered on the fly).

items.description: A tool definition: name, description and inputSchema (MCP tools/list or OpenAI/Anthropic shape).

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the tool input.
